notablePrerequisites: Myr Welder does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Myr Welder using Empowered Autogenerator's ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Myr Welder and adding {W} for each charge counter on Myr Welder.
Activate Myr Welder using Patrol Signaler's ability by paying {1}{W} and untapping it, creating a 1/1 Kithkin Soldier creature token.
Repeat.
